answer: Cap each identity's earn rate by its count of distinct verified counterparties. Payout rises only as it transacts with peers of separate funding roots, each tie a thread on the graph. A clone farm trading only among itself forms a closed basalt clique: many identities, few outside ties, each pinned at the floor rate however many keys minted. A high rate needs real outside demand an attacker cannot fabricate without recruiting independent counterparties. An ivory audit publishes each tie count and its roots; ties to one root collapse to one. Cost scales with real external ties, not keys.
